title: Inbox rules
intro: Automatically organise incoming messages as they arrive. For example, route emails from your bank directly to a specific folder, or apply an "Invoice" label to matching subject lines. Rules run sequentially from top to bottom and never apply to messages filtered as spam.
none: Create your first rule to automatically filter, label or sort incoming mail.
deleteConfirm: Delete this rule? Mail it has already sorted stays where it is.

noLabels: You don't have any labels yet. Make one from the sidebar.

needCondition: Fill in at least one condition.
needAction: Choose at least one thing for the rule to do.
applied: Rule saved. It sorted {n} conversations already in your Inbox.
appliedOne: Rule saved. It sorted 1 conversation already in your Inbox.
appliedNone: Rule saved. Nothing in your Inbox matched it.
failed: That didn't save. Please try again.
quietNote: Emails automatically moved out of the inbox or marked as read by a rule will not trigger new-mail notifications.
